searchText: to be more precise, in the following cases, we don't charge the account write for authority - is `tx.sender`, covered by `TX_BASE_COST`; - was written by a preceding valid authorization; - is `tx.to` of a value-bearing transaction, covered by `TX_VALUE_COST`; Hi all! I am starting to clean up the repricing EIPs. But before finishing it, I wanted to understand what to do with https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/11891 Should we merge this before, <@830368514225340436> and <@402853454126776320> ? Yes Yup. I think this PR has some good clarifications that are helpful to implementers Thank you, merging now
